title: WF03 ADP-05 coverage blocker: explicit artifact_repository replay-source positive test missing
summary: Resolved ADP05-COVERAGE-RISK-01 by adding explicit deterministic integration coverage for the positive replay-source selection path, asserting ReplayDefinitionSource.artifact_repository when the provided definition hash equals the canonical snapshot hash.

root_cause.details: Replay source logic already supported artifact_repository selection for canonical hash/snapshot equivalence, but the ADP-05 integration suite asserted only snapshot_fallback branches (null/mismatched hash). TEST-RUNNER therefore could not trace the positive MUST behavior to executable passing evidence.

changes: Added computeSnapshotArtifactHash helper in tests/integration/adp05_instance_artifact_hash_test.zig to derive canonical SHA-256 snapshot hash deterministically.
Added TC-ADP-05-06 asserting determineReplaySourceForSnapshot returns ReplayDefinitionSource.artifact_repository when canonical hash matches snapshot graph.

prevention: When test specs flag deterministic coverage risk, include both positive and fallback path assertions before WF-02 Step-04 validation.
For hash-based replay decisions, keep deterministic test helpers that derive canonical hashes directly from the persisted snapshot graph.
